name: egroupware
shortDescription: Software suite including calendars, address books, notepad, project management tools, client relationship management tools (CRM), knowledge management tools, a wiki and a CMS.
agentSummary: egroupware is self-hostable software from the Awesome Selfhosted data index. Agents can inspect the source, deploy it in a controlled environment, and operate the browser UI; API or CLI support should be verified in project docs.
bestFor: Self-hosted groupware workflows, internal tools, and controlled deployment experiments.
cautionNotes: Key limitations: generated from community metadata, not a full security review. Verify maintenance activity, license, deployment docs, auth model, backup and restore path, update process, API or CLI support, and data exposure before production agent automation. CLI access is powerful but can run destructive local or production commands; prefer dry runs, preview environments, and non-production credentials. Browser automation can be brittle around UI changes, MFA, captchas, policy prompts, and hidden confirmation states.
pricingSummary: Self-hosted/open-source licensing listed as GPL-2.0; infrastructure costs vary by deployment.
